using a white VW Gol in the Jardim das Palmeiras neighbourhood. During
patrols, military police found the vehicle but the driver tried to flee; after a
short chase through several blocks he was caught and stopped.

drug-packaging materials and money.

inquiries and found two other people at a snack bar. Officers later found
59 tablets of a substance similar to marijuana, totalling about 54 kilograms.

RCN67 confirms 59 marijuana tablets weighing about 54 kilograms were found at a
second address.

The people involved were taken to the Civil Police station in Água Clara for
legal proceedings.

Five men were arrested in total: four in flagrante for drug trafficking and
association for trafficking, and one on an outstanding arrest warrant.

report.summary: Spain's UDYCO drug unit arrested a truck driver at the port of Ceuta after finding a hidden compartment packed with bags of hashish. Outlets estimate the haul at about 300 kilograms, pending an official weighing.
report.body:
Spain's UDYCO drug unit arrested a truck driver at the port of Ceuta carrying a
stash of hashish hidden in a sophisticated false bottom. Officers
intercepted the truck on the port road at the Muelle de Poniente and searched it
with support from the UPR prevention unit and the canine group. They found
the hashish and detained the driver, showing him the drugs found in the vehicle
he was driving.

The truck appeared empty and was heading toward boarding for Spain when a
specialist drugs dog alerted, prompting an exhaustive hours-long search inside
and outside the vehicle. After the hours-long detailed inspection, officers
found a large number of bags full of hashish inside the truck's structure.
Officers recovered numerous bags of hashish from the trailer's false bottom,
with first estimates putting the haul above 300 kilograms although police gave
no official weight. The submitted account describes the seizure as about
300 kilograms of hashish arriving from Morocco.

The handcuffed driver was taken to police headquarters and placed under
investigation for an offence against public health. Police link the
operation to open UDYCO investigations into groups moving hashish from Ceuta to
mainland Spain in heavy vehicles with hidden compartments. A judge ordered the driver remanded in preventive prison on Sunday, after he appeared before the court for an offence against public health.

membership in a drug-trafficking group, and seized 60 kilos of hashish and
weapons. The Grupo I de Estupefacientes of the National Police concluded an

organisation. In the second home, officers arrested a second suspect
accused of storing and transporting drugs, and found two kilos of cocaine,
doses, cutting substance, a 9mm pistol with cartridges, a bow and arrows, and a
hydraulic press for compressing cocaine. A fifth person was arrested in
connection with the case. Agents of the Prevention and Reaction Unit, the
Grupo II de Estupefacientes and the Canine Guides also took part in the
